decision.msg: Cost is WRITTEN into task.jsonl (an assign with cost_usd), not computed in the view. The view runs on a static site in production and cannot read %LOCALAPPDATA%'s registry or agent logs; the task log is the durable record that already travels with the task. The tool is idempotent and re-runnable, because a mastermind's own last turn is billed after it lands. Alternative: a dev-server endpoint the view queries live — rejected, it shows nothing on the static site and nothing once Servex's logs rotate.

A task with no Servex agent (a tab, a CLI session) gets no cost line and the view says 'not tracked', never $0. A sub-task whose root agent descends from another task's root, or a second task on the same root agent, carries cost.parent_task so day and group totals count each dollar once.

assign.outcome:
**Every task now shows what it cost in dollars, including its minions, and the day and each effort show their totals.**

- **See it:** the [day page](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/) reads "$202.87+ today", with one total per effort (ai log $115, servex $29, pages $22 …). Every task card shows its figure, marked "+ so far" while agents are still running. A task's own page breaks it down: the root agent, its own cost, its minions', and how many agents.
- **Proof:** [live-card](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/live-card/) $12.93 · [md-pages](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/md-pages/) $12.53 · [loose-ends](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/loose-ends/) $49.86 across 193 agents, $38.64 of it minions. live-card's and md-pages' helpers ran inside the mastermind's own session, so their cost is already in its figure.
- **How:** `Server/task-cost.mjs` adds up a task's Servex agent and every agent under it, and writes `cost_usd` into the task's log. The figure is stored in the log rather than worked out on the page, because the published site can't read Servex's files ([doc](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/cost.md)). A sub-task, or a second task on the same agent, is counted once.
- **Not tracked, never $0:** a task run from a tab or a plain CLI session has no Servex agent, and one that hasn't been billed yet shows the same.

![day page, 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/task-cost/after-day-1280.png)

**Left:** Servex re-runs the tool after every agent result, but only after its next restart (merged, not yet live). I didn't restart it myself because the last restart killed a working minion. Until then, run `node Server/task-cost.mjs --date <day>` by hand.
